message: NFR-1 (<150ms glass-to-glass) will NOT be met by v1. Accepted at the clarify gate: v1 ships screenshot polling behind a MirrorTransport interface, with scrcpy-server + in-JVM H.264 decode as an explicit v1.1+ follow-up. Grounds: no H.264 decoder exists anywhere on the classpath (verified against gradle/libs.versions.toml), building one is disproportionate to this deliverable, and the staged interface makes the real transport a drop-in replacement. Deliberate, not an oversight. MUST appear in the final chain report to the operator.

Brainstorm surfaced a pre-existing repo gap it correctly did NOT silently patch: domain-usecase-impl resultLauncher catches Throwable, which includes CancellationException, so any coroutine timeout inside a use case must use withTimeoutOrNull rather than withTimeout or real cancellation gets swallowed and mapped to a Failure. Affects every existing use case, not just this spec. Carried as a follow-up for the batched retrospective.
